verdict.rationale: Treg is a developer-facing API product, so official SDKs are a fair question. The evidence pack shows none: no language-specific SDK packages, install instructions, or SDK reference docs are documented anywhere. The REST API, OpenAPI spec, CLI, MCP endpoint and llms.txt are real programmatic surfaces, but each is scored on its own story (agentic-public-api, api-machine-spec, agentic-official-cli, agentic-mcp-server, agentic-agent-docs) and none of them is an official SDK library. Missing for 10: any official SDK (e.g., Python/TypeScript packages), SDK documentation or install instructions, and independent corroboration of building against an SDK.
